scope: F02: five-case changed-path long-only exit replay, no live changes or new indicator/HL/SR sweep
sourceExtensionScope: Optional research-only pro-rata/full reduction hook, episode no-readd latch, additional research-order latency; independent auditor admits only those labeled reductions. Four unchanged B17 result digests must match before variants.
checkpoint: First end-minute depth>=9/gross inventory PnL<=-3 per episode. Exactly +60m: same episode remains open/depth>=9. No repeat or requirement to still be below -3. Existing exits/SR reductions take precedence. Unknown indicator means no experimental exit; normal protections remain enabled.

full: Next-open full close; ordinary live4h forced cooldown=(floor(fillAt/4h)+2)*4h, then existing entry gates. Replacement episodes are re-simulated, not borrowed from baseline.
sensitivityScope: All four windows/models: primary five cases; source60 MFI cases only (blind controls identical); fill60 all four interventions. Extra latency applies only to experimental exit orders, existing exits retain priority. 44 runs total, including four controls. +5bps each-side cost stress on fixed resulting paths is separately labeled, not an affordability rerun.
report: Baseline adjacent: completed episode W/L, winning/losing dollars including trims, total realized plus final open mark, DD, monthly MTM and closed-episode W/L, matched/removed/replacement contribution, actual interventions and censoring, late/early concentration and both sensitivities. Never pool overlapping models/windows. Exploratory selection from P01 109 bins, not untouched validation; forward observation still required. Funding settlements/maker matching/liquidation are NOT modeled.
